stories.title: Ukrainian and Russian troops fight inside old Soviet gas pipeline in Kharkiv
stories.summary: For roughly seven months Ukrainian forces have been living and engaging Russian troops inside an old Soviet gas pipeline in Ukraine’s Kharkiv region. The pipe is just over a metre in diameter, so combatants can only crawl, but its underground position shields them from the heavy drone activity that dominates the front‑line skies and hampers surface movements for both sides.
stories.why: The underground fighting shows how both sides are adapting tactics to counter pervasive drone surveillance and strikes.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs projects RBI to raise rates by 75 bps in Q2 2027
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs expects the Reserve Bank of India to increase its policy interest rate by 75 basis points by the second quarter of 2027. The firm projects headline inflation to stay above 6 percent into early 2027 before easing gradually. It also forecasts that India’s GDP growth will moderate to about 7.2 percent in 2027, supported by strong domestic demand and an emerging investment cycle.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: India on track to meet $1 trillion export target by FY 2026‑27, says commerce secretary
stories.summary: India’s exports rose 16.6% in the first half of the current fiscal year, taking total shipments to a record $863 billion in the previous fiscal year. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the country remains on course to achieve its goal of $1 trillion in exports by FY 2026‑27, despite ongoing global trade uncertainties. The government continues to view India as a trusted trading partner.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: India, US Near Completion of Trade Deal Negotiations, Signing Dependent on US Tariff Rules
stories.summary: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the legal texts for the India‑US trade agreement are almost finalized, indicating the negotiations are close to completion. The parties cannot sign the deal until the United States establishes new tariff rules and resolves the ongoing Section 301 investigations.
